_comment: Oxeegen Hermes: the ONE place for Oxeegen endpoints and models (model ids still PROVISIONAL). Each region has its own endpoint AND its own API key. Users store their region id (OXEEGEN_REGION) and one key per region (regions.<id>.api_key_env) in .env; the ACTIVE pair read by the runtime and the managed scope — api_key_env / base_url_env — is derived from them by the desktop on save and by plugins/model-providers/oxeegen/__init__.py on every backend start, so an endpoint changed here reaches every install with the next update. Read by that plugin, the desktop (apps/desktop/src/oxeegen/config.ts) and oxeegen/scripts/gen-managed.py.
